exclusions.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) 0-1
Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥50%, as assessed by echocardiogram (ECHO) or multiple-gated acquisition scan (MUGA) documented within 12 weeks prior to first dose of study treatment
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 x ULN (institutional) OR calculated GFR ≥60mL/min
exclusions.threshold: creatinine ≤ 1.5 x ULN or GFR ≥60 mL/min

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN (institutional) or direct bilirubin within normal limits in patients with a history of Gilbert\'s syndrome.
AST and ALT ≤ 2.5 x ULN (institutional) or ≤ 5 x ULN for participants with documented liver metastases
Participants with concurrent human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection are eligible provided the following criteria are met:
Participants with brain metastases identified at diagnosis or at time of screening are eligible if the following criteria are met:

Participants with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen are eligible
Women of childbearing potential must have had a negative pregnancy test within 14 days of registration.
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because of potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects of study drugs.
breastfeeding should be discontinued prior to enrollment.
Prior history of invasive breast carcinoma
Participants with a medical history of myocardial infarction within 6 months before enrollment or symptomatic CHF (NYHA Class II to IV).
exclusions.threshold: MI within 6 months; NYHA Class II to IV

exclusions.source_text: Known or concurrent leptomeningeal disease on screening MRI
Any untreated brain lesion on screening MRI, unless approved by the Sponsor Investigator
History of arrhythmia (multifocal premature ventricular contractions, bigeminy, trigeminy, ventricular tachycardia), which is symptomatic or requires treatment (CTCAE Grade 3)
